name: Wolf (BB)

source.title: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

items.name: Pack Attack
items.text: The wolf's jaws Strike deals 1d4 extra damage to creatures within reach of two of the wolf's allies.

items.name: Knockdown
items.text: When the wolf succeeds at its jaws Strike, it can use this action immediately after to attempt to trip the target. This Trip doesn't apply or count toward the wolf's multiple attack penalty.

text: Wolves roam forests, hills, and other wild lands where they live and hunt in packs. Contrary to popular belief, these packs aren't led by the strongest in the group, but typically consist of a mated pair, their pups, and juvenile offspring from previous mating seasons. Offspring generally leave their parents' pack upon reaching maturity, at which point they seek out mates of their own to form their own packs elsewhere. Wolves don't typically view humanoids as prey animals, but extraordinary circumstances can lead wolves to attack people, especially in winter months and other situations where traditional prey (such as deer and elk) are scarce.
